topic: Telegram and WhatsApp Investment Scams Alert
caption:
"Daily ₹5000 fixed profit" ka message aaya hai kabhi? 🚩
Telegram aur WhatsApp par aajkal financial scams bohot badh gaye hain.
Thodi si lalach mein log apni mehnat ki kamai gawa dete hain.
Slide karo aur samjho ki in scammers se khud ko kaise protect karein.
Kya aapko kabhi aisa koi fake investment message aaya hai? Comment mein batao!
